preserve.otherFields: unchanged; re-read actual editor before save

beforeWrite: Fresh read verifies exact existing unselected plan, terms and access; stop on drift. No new plan or changes to currently selected old development plan.
afterSave: Read editor and native merchant pricing; require exactly recurring-only Standard with no usage item, effective zero development price and existing old plan preserved.
selection: Separate bounded authority required for amended recurring-only terms. Only proceed when provider explicitly identifies this as zero-cost development testing, exact handle/shop and no meter. Verify confirmation and independently read resulting current subscription, trial/cycle and items. Stop on ambiguity; no blind retry.
knownRouteLimit: Owner exact editor works; server editor returned HTTP422. Existing Admin/Dev sessions verified; do not repeat CAPTCHA/login attempts.
